item.title: Creamy Baked Eggs and Bacon - Salt Harvest Creatives
item.description: Getting bored of scrambled eggs? Try this quick and fresh recipe for Creamy Baked Eggs and Bacon. It's no fuss and easy!

item.title: Miso and Carrot Salad Dressing - Salt Harvest Creatives
item.description: Miso and Carrot salad dressing is a slightly sweet and slightly umami salad dressing that pairs well with bitter arugula. We love making this dressing and serving it with a basic salad of tomatoes, cucumbers, and arugula – by keeping the salad simple, the robust dressing really shines. Since the dressing calls for apple, this dressing is best used within 24 hours.

item.title: Baked Feta and Tomato Pasta - Salt Harvest Creatives
item.description: What's better than garden fresh tomatoes in a one-pot dish?! This baked feta and tomato pasta dish is breeze to make and a crowd pleaser!

item.title: Baked Feta and Tomato Pasta - Salt Harvest Creatives
item.description: Summer is approaching, and soon our Sacramento gardens will be filled with an overabundance of tomatoes. This baked feta and tomato pasta is an easy way to incorporate the fruits of your garden. What makes this one dish so simple is that the feta cheese and tomatoes need minimal prep work – just dump them in the dish as is. Though this recipe uses cherry tomatoes, any small variety will do. This version has a kick of spice, but omit the chili flakes if you plan on serving it to kids. Enjoy!

item.title: Fresh Garden Pesto - Salt Harvest Creatives
item.description: Fresh garden pesto screams summer, and it can elevate a basic meal in seconds. Though there are many ways to incorporate pesto in the kitchen, we love to toss this pesto with penne and Parmesan. Plus, it makes a great sandwich topping when spread between crusty bread, mozzarella, arugula, and prosciutto! item.description: Fennel doesn't get the love it deserves, but it shines in this salad! Make this spring salad with fennel for a fresh combination!

item.title: Biscuits and Gravy Breakfast Casserole - Salt Harvest Creatives
item.description: Grab some dough for breakfast biscuits and whip out the gravy! This is a hearty and satisfying breakfast which is perfect for a crowd.

item.description: Make this amazingly elegant salad as an appetizer or main meal! Elegant and easy, it's a perfect blend of fall flavors.

item.description: Feel like a funky and unique appetizer? These tiny olives are exploding with savory blue cheese and anchovies. Air fry them and enjoy!

item.title: How we got a book deal ~ The Unofficial Ted Lasso Cookbook - Salt Harvest Creatives
item.description: Publishing a book or cookbook is an exciting endeavor that many people aspire to, and we want to share our story of how we landed a cookbook deal with HarperCollins – even though we had zero previous book experience. Of course, everyone’s situation, audience, and market are different, so our experience might not be directly transferable on your book journey.
